prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV (sunbed) tanning or spray/airbrush tanning? Also, which part of Columbus are you in or what zip code do you want options near? With that I can give targeted recommendations.

Until then, here are quick tips to find the “best” salon for you:

- Decide type: spray/airbrush (no UV) vs. tanning beds (UV). Spray is safer; high-pressure beds give quicker color with less frequent sessions but still carry UV risks.
- Check recent reviews: Google Maps, Yelp, and Facebook—look for consistent praise for cleanliness, staff professionalism, and accurate results more than one-off 5-star posts.
- Inspect equipment & hygiene: beds/booths should look clean, linens or protective paper changed between clients, and staff should provide/require eye protection.
- Ask about staff training and skin assessments: good salons ask about skin type, medications, and tailor sessions.
- Ask what beds/booths they use: high-pressure vs low-pressure, stand-up vs lay-down, and the brand/age of bulbs (newer bulbs give better results).
- Pricing & memberships: compare single sessions vs monthly memberships; hidden fees (towel, solution) matter.
- Test with a sample: for spray tans, request a patch test or a lower-coverage trial. For UV tanning, start with a shorter session.
- Safety: don’t exceed recommended frequency; use protective eyewear; avoid UV if you have a history of skin cancer or take photosensitizing meds.

If you tell me which neighborhood or whether you prefer spray or UV, I’ll give a short list of well-reviewed Columbus salons and suggested questions to ask each.
